direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets at least 36px, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main; condense side content inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; header tabs span most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls, never conflating them; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text

Animate one emerald route trace when verified findings arrive, then settle static; honour prefers-reduced-motion.
Make verified-fact rows bidirectionally highlight Certificate, Receiving and substitute nodes in the SVG, with visible focus ring.
Clarify that selecting a path opens one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall; label the current primary as the review entry to that flow.
Add depth and feasible-route glow only to selectable paths in the scene, keeping one primary action in the action bar.
Enlarge path tradeoff metrics to tabular 26px where feasible while preserving viewport fit at 1366x768.
Retain the clear PROPOSED and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL labelling; do not mark proposed tasks as tracked before human approval.

Untruncate the third task title inside its reserved zone through tighter copy rather than widening cards.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 preview in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain WILL GO OFFLINE text; ensure no route is drawn through it.
Strengthen the cinematic 24h to 0h transition with a single 240ms capacity drain tied to real state, removed under reduced motion.
Make the machine selector at least 36px tall with a 2px emerald focus ring and arrow-key friendly native behaviour.
Keep provider identity readiness separate from Reinvestigate recovery: give each its own heading, status line and control in the side zone.
Remove the diagonal line crossing CELL-MILL-2 text; rely on silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text for legibility.
Add a short feasible-route trace from CELL-MILL-1 to both jobs showing 3 to 2 paths, static under reduced motion.
Keep the constrained Split option hatched with x marker and plain reason text, and ensure its disabled control has no pointer style.
Clarify the next consent flow on selection: one-click Approve followed by the Authorize this decision wall.
Increase glow only on the two remaining feasible paths to reinforce revised capacity at a glance.
Preserve coexistence wording: blocked prior tasks plus approved revised plan while replacement tasks await approval, with proposed tasks untracked until approval.
Show CELL-MILL-2 as plain OFFLINE with silver cross-hatching and x marker inside the board scene, matching the legend.
Untruncate the third replacement task title within its zone and add state glow to the approved plan summary.
Add depth and a cinematic dashed-chain trace across Verify, Seal and Retain driven by completion state, static under reduced motion.
Enlarge side-zone body copy to 16px minimum by condensing the passphrase guidance to one concise sentence.
Ensure each proof stage is keyboard focusable with emerald focus ring and aria-live polite result announcements.
Keep every stopped machine in silver with x marker and plain OFFLINE text; strengthen the emerald mills to lathes living flow as the sole feasible path.
Add subtle depth between department zones without reducing scene fill, and keep routes clear of machine glyphs.
Make department zones and running machines keyboard focusable with bidirectional side highlighting and visible focus ring.
Keep the required presentation order; sharpen judge impact by enlarging the cascade visual and its caption so 35 affected operations and the feasible mills to lathes path read at a glance.
Raise small table and caption text toward 16px for faster scanning while keeping the one-line pitch prominent.
Add alt text for hero and cascade visuals describing Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80, silver OFFLINE machines and the emerald recovery path.
